d:
PKL yani pro kabaddi lig ne bhartiy kabaddi ki tasvir aur khilariyon ki takdir donon ko ek naye mukam par pahuncha diya hai. jo khel kabhi sirph ganv ki galiyon aur mitti ke akharon tak simta huaa tha, aaj vah tivi skrin par karoron darshakon ki pahli pasand ban chuka hai.
